question: Question linked to image nº13 A 31-year-old man reported a sudden onset of chills, high fever, joint and muscle pain, maculopapular rash predominantly in the extremities, headache and photophobia. He lives in a suburban residential area of ​​the Spanish Levante. Physical examination highlights the blackish eschar that can be seen in the image.
